title: slots_post resp_buf[128] too small: valid max-slot claims get 5.00 instead of 2.04
description: coap_slot_coord.c:1495 - encode_grant needs 173 B worst case (60x 2-byte slots), 149 B natural 0..59; empirically fails from ~40 high-numbered slots (129 B). Valid spec-max claims are rejected with 5.00 after full signature verification. Fix: size resp_buf >= 192 and add a host test exercising encode_grant at 60 slots (the suite currently never exercises the grant-encode path because slots_post is compiled out on host).
